research_scope: Time Skip/Jump Spike — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Time Skip/Jump Spike as a Strike Super and Counter Skill; canonical identity is Super / Strike.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Hit's Lesson 2 is the documented Future Warrior route; an instructor guide lists Time Skip/Jump Spike as the Basic Reward for Hit's Lesson 2.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Future Warrior can learn the skill; usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Super Pack 1 is the associated DLC context because it adds Hit as a master and his mentor skill set.
verification_audit.finish_policy: Instructor-training acquisition, not a PQ reward; ultimate_finish_required is false.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: User flies forward and time-skips into a strike, with approximately 20% damage reported by the reference. The rush has protection against Strike attacks and holding the input extends flight range. Exact current frame/range/damage measurements remain unverified.
evidence_limits: Exact active frames, hitbox/range and current damage require direct testing.
Community evidence describes the move as a forward straight-line attack and discusses counter/grab interactions, but does not establish precise current frame data.
No PQ drop probability or Ultimate Finish dependency applies.

records.name: Time Skip/Jump Spike
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: Documented acquisition is instructor training, not a Parallel Quest reward.
records.skill_description: Fly and then time skip before attacking an opponent. Holding longer increases flight distance.
records.mechanics_notes: The user flies forward and time-skips into a strike for approximately 20% damage according to the maintained reference. Strike protection is reported during the rush, and holding the input extends flight distance. Exact current frames, range and damage remain unverified.
records.acquisition_notes: Hit's Lesson 2 is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route; an instructor guide lists Time Skip/Jump Spike as its Basic Reward. Super Pack 1 officially adds Hit as a master.
records.pve_notes: Forward rush can be difficult for AI to evade, but exact current AI behavior is not independently verified.
records.pvp_notes: Community discussion identifies the move as a forward straight-line attack and notes counter/grab interactions; exact current frame data is not independently verified.
